citation_note: Primary DADLE/DOR pharmacology and delta-opioid Gi coupling are combined with primary delta-opioid agonist CREB-phosphorylation evidence; PMID:10708700 used DPDPE rather than DADLE, so the TF/output layer is a bounded agonist-family overlay.
evidence_summary: Primary evidence supports DADLE engagement of cloned OPRD1/DOR with forskolin-stimulated cAMP inhibition, a DOR-to-GNAI receptor-proximal continuation, and delta-opioid agonist-associated CREB phosphorylation. The route is retained as a composite evidence-layer route for plausibility analysis.
limitations: The DADLE/DOR/GNAI papers and the DPDPE/DOR/CREB-phosphorylation paper are complementary primary systems rather than one end-to-end DADLE experiment. The exact DADLE-to-CREB handoff, target-gene expression, direct CREB occupancy, native cell context, and SCI receiver-cell transfer remain unasserted; no causal traversal or confidence score is inferred.
cell_type_context: Cloned human OPRD1/DOR receptor systems for DADLE pharmacology; NG108-15 cells for delta-opioid agonist CREB-phosphorylation readout.
compartment_context: extracellular ligand; plasma-membrane DOR; cytoplasmic Gi/cAMP signaling; nucleus-associated CREB phosphorylation readout
injury_context: no SCI transfer inferred; primary model context only
context_scope: composite primary evidence; exact DADLE-to-CREB handoff remains bounded
assay_or_perturbation: DADLE receptor binding and forskolin-stimulated cAMP inhibition; delta-opioid Gi coupling; opioid agonist CREB phosphorylation with receptor antagonist and kinase-pathway perturbation
